provenance: hooks/bg-watchdog-monitor-guard.sh's own tests/monitor-guard.test.sh asserts 'malformed stdin fails open' (its 9th and last unit test, confirmed green: `bash tests/monitor-guard.test.sh` -> 9 passed). Replayed here as a robustness case even with the guard enabled: a truncated or non-JSON hook payload must never wedge a session by denying a tool call it couldn't parse. Uses 'raw_input' (literal stdin bytes) instead of 'input' (JSON-serialized) since the whole point is that stdin ISN'T valid JSON.
